Name: Coffee In The Fall (1.6)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
This is an update of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52288831]cobaltcrowsprite[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4117]Coffee In The Fall[/url]. It now works in 1.6 and uses a more reliable mechanism to ensure your Coffee grows all the way through Fall. The other mod still kind of works, but sometimes your Coffee will die part way through fall and sometimes you won't be able to plant it at all.

This mod also updates the description to reflect, and be a helpful reminder, that Coffee can now grow in the fall. You could also use this mod, or others like it, as a framework to make this work for any crop and/work for more than just fall (like Winter, as well).﻿

[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
Like this mod? [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dyanosis/mods]Check out my other mods![/url]
